metric.label: Lexical baseline
metric.description: Character n-gram cosine distance. This is a reproducible lexical baseline, not a semantic or faithfulness score.

units.leftText: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, To the saints in Ephesus, the faithful in Christ Jesus:
units.rightText: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints that are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:
leftNotes: 1:1 Some manuscripts do not include in Ephesus.

units.leftText: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. Spiritual Blessings (Romans 8:28–34|ROM 8:28-34*)
units.rightText: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

units.leftText: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms.
units.rightText: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ:

units.leftText: For He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world to be holy and blameless in His presence. In love
units.rightText: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blemish before him in love:

units.leftText: He predestined us for adoption as His sons through Jesus Christ, according to the good pleasure of His will,
units.rightText: having foreordained us unto adoption as sons through Jesus Christ unto himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

units.leftText: to the praise of His glorious grace, which He has freely given us in the Beloved One.
units.rightText: to the praise of the glory of his grace, which he freely bestowed on us in the Beloved:

units.leftText: In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of His grace
units.rightText: in whom we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,

units.leftText: that He lavished on us with all wisdom and understanding.
units.rightText: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

units.leftText: And He has made known to us the mystery of His will according to His good pleasure, which He purposed in Christ
units.rightText: making known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

units.leftText: as a plan for the fullness of time, to bring all things in heaven and on earth together in Christ.
units.rightText: unto a dispensation of the fulness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens, and the things upon the earth; in him, I say,

units.leftText: In Him we were also chosen as God’s own, having been predestined according to the plan of Him who works out everything by the counsel of His will,
units.rightText: in whom also we were made a heritage, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his will;

units.leftText: in order that we, who were the first to hope in Christ, would be for the praise of His glory.
units.rightText: to the end that we should be unto the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ:

units.leftText: And in Him, having heard and believed the word of truth — the gospel of your salvation — you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,
units.rightText: in whom ye also, having heard the word of the truth, the gospel of your salvation,—in whom, having also believed, ye were sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise,

units.leftText: who is the pledge of our inheritance until the redemption of those who are God’s possession, to the praise of His glory. Spiritual Wisdom (1 Corinthians 2:6–16|1CO 2:6-16*)
units.rightText: which is an earnest of our inheritance, unto the redemption of God’s own possession, unto the praise of his glory.

units.leftText: For this reason, ever since I heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints,
units.rightText: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you, and the love which ye show toward all the saints,

units.leftText: I have not stopped giving thanks for you, remembering you in my prayers,
units.rightText: cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;

units.leftText: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in your knowledge of Him.
units.rightText: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him;

units.leftText: I ask that the eyes of your heart may be enlightened, so that you may know the hope of His calling, the riches of His glorious inheritance in the saints,
units.rightText: having the eyes of your heart enlightened, that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
leftNotes: 1:18 TR the eyes of your understanding

units.leftText: and the surpassing greatness of His power to us who believe. These are in accordance with the working of His mighty strength,
units.rightText: and what the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might

units.leftText: which He exerted in Christ when He raised Him from the dead and seated Him at His right hand in the heavenly realms,
units.rightText: which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,

units.leftText: far above all rule and authority, power and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in the present age but also in the one to come.
units.rightText: far above all rule, and authority, and power, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:

units.leftText: And God put everything under His feet and made Him head over everything for the church,
units.rightText: and he put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things to the church,

units.leftText: which is His body, the fullness of Him who fills all in all.
units.rightText: which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.

units.leftText: And you were dead in your trespasses and sins,
units.rightText: And you did he make alive, when ye were dead through your trespasses and sins,

units.leftText: in which you used to walk when you conformed to the ways of this world and of the ruler of the power of the air, the spirit who is now at work in the sons of disobedience.
units.rightText: wherein ye once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the powers of the air, of the spirit that now worketh in the sons of disobedience;

units.leftText: All of us also lived among them at one time, fulfilling the cravings of our flesh and indulging its desires and thoughts. Like the rest, we were by nature children of wrath.
units.rightText: among whom we also all once lived in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest:—

units.leftText: But because of His great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy,
units.rightText: but God, being rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,

units.leftText: made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in our trespasses. It is by grace you have been saved!
units.rightText: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ (by grace have ye been saved),

units.leftText: And God raised us up with Christ and seated us with Him in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus,
units.rightText: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places, in Christ Jesus:

units.leftText: in order that in the coming ages He might display the surpassing riches of His grace, demonstrated by His kindness to us in Christ Jesus.
units.rightText: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus:

units.leftText: For it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God,
units.rightText: for by grace have ye been saved through faith; and that not of yourselves, it is the gift of God;

units.leftText: not by works, so that no one can boast.
units.rightText: not of works, that no man should glory.

units.leftText: For we are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance as our way of life. One in Christ (Philippians 2:1–4|PHP 2:1-4*)
units.rightText: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God afore prepared that we should walk in them.
leftNotes: 2:10 Literally which God prepared beforehand, that we should walk in them.

units.leftText: Therefore remember that formerly you who are Gentiles in the flesh and called uncircumcised by the so-called circumcision (that done in the body by human hands) —
units.rightText: Wherefore remember, that once ye, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called Circumcision, in the flesh, made by hands;

units.leftText: remember that at that time you were separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers to the covenants of the promise, without hope and without God in the world.
units.rightText: that ye were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.

units.leftText: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far away have been brought near through the blood of Christ.
units.rightText: But now in Christ Jesus ye that once were far off are made nigh in the blood of Christ.

units.leftText: For He Himself is our peace, who has made the two one and has torn down the dividing wall of hostility
units.rightText: For he is our peace, who made both one, and brake down the middle wall of partition,

units.leftText: by abolishing in His flesh the law of commandments and decrees. He did this to create in Himself one new man out of the two, thus making peace
units.rightText: having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; that he might create in himself of the two one new man, so making peace;

units.leftText: and reconciling both of them to God in one body through the cross, by which He put to death their hostility.
units.rightText: and might reconcile them both in one body unto God through the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:

units.leftText: He came and preached peace to you who were far away and peace to those who were near.
units.rightText: and he came and preached peace to you that were far off, and peace to them that were nigh:

units.leftText: For through Him we both have access to the Father by one Spirit. Christ Our Cornerstone (Isaiah 28:14–22|ISA 28:14-22*; 1 Corinthians 3:10–15|1CO 3:10-15*; 1 Peter 2:1–8|1PE 2:1-8*)
units.rightText: for through him we both have our access in one Spirit unto the Father.

units.leftText: Therefore you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but fellow citizens with the saints and members of God’s household,
units.rightText: So then ye are no more strangers and sojourners, but ye are fellow-citizens with the saints, and of the household of God,

units.leftText: built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus Himself as the cornerstone.
units.rightText: being built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief corner stone;

units.leftText: In Him the whole building is fitted together and grows into a holy temple in the Lord.
units.rightText: in whom each several building, fitly framed together, groweth into a holy temple in the Lord;

units.leftText: And in Him you too are being built together into a dwelling place for God in His Spirit.
units.rightText: in whom ye also are builded together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.

units.leftText: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles...
units.rightText: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus in behalf of you Gentiles,—
leftNotes: 3:1 This train of thought is continued in verse 14.

units.leftText: Surely you have heard about the stewardship of God’s grace that was given to me for you,
units.rightText: if so be that ye have heard of the dispensation of that grace of God which was given me to you-ward;

units.leftText: that is, the mystery made known to me by revelation, as I have already written briefly.
units.rightText: how that by revelation was made known unto me the mystery, as I wrote before in few words,

units.leftText: In reading this, then, you will be able to understand my insight into the mystery of Christ,
units.rightText: whereby, when ye read, ye can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ;

units.leftText: which was not made known to men in other generations as it has now been revealed by the Spirit to God’s holy apostles and prophets.
units.rightText: which in other generations was not made known unto the sons of men, as it hath now been revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit;

units.leftText: This mystery is that through the gospel the Gentiles are fellow heirs, fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus.
units.rightText: to wit, that the Gentiles are fellow-heirs, and fellow-members of the body, and fellow-partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus through the gospel,

units.leftText: I became a servant of this gospel by the gift of God’s grace, given me through the working of His power.
units.rightText: whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.

units.leftText: Though I am less than the least of all the saints, this grace was given me: to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
units.rightText: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach unto the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;

units.leftText: and to illuminate for everyone the stewardship of this mystery, which for ages past was kept hidden in God, who created all things.
units.rightText: and to make all men see what is the dispensation of the mystery which for ages hath been hid in God who created all things;
leftNotes: 3:9 NE and WH and to illuminate the stewardship; TR and to illuminate for everyone the fellowship

units.leftText: His purpose was that now, through the church, the manifold wisdom of God should be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms,
units.rightText: to the intent that now unto the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places might be made known through the church the manifold wisdom of God,

units.leftText: according to the eternal purpose that He accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.
units.rightText: according to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:

units.leftText: In Him and through faith in Him we may enter God’s presence with boldness and confidence.
units.rightText: in whom we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

units.leftText: So I ask you not to be discouraged because of my sufferings for you, which are your glory. Paul’s Prayer for the Ephesians
units.rightText: Wherefore I ask that ye may not faint at my tribulations for you, which are your glory.

units.leftText: ... for this reason I bow my knees before the Father,
units.rightText: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father,
leftNotes: 3:14 BYZ and TR before the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

units.leftText: from whom every family in heaven and on earth derives its name.
units.rightText: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

units.leftText: I ask that out of the riches of His glory He may strengthen you with power through His Spirit in your inner being,
units.rightText: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that ye may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inward man;

units.leftText: so that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith. Then you, being rooted and grounded in love,
units.rightText: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith; to the end that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,

units.leftText: will have power, together with all the saints, to comprehend the length and width and height and depth
units.rightText: may be strong to apprehend with all the saints what is the breadth and length and height and depth,

units.leftText: of the love of Christ, and to know this love that surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
units.rightText: and to know the love of Christ which passeth knowledge, that ye may be filled unto all the fulness of God.

units.leftText: Now to Him who is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,
units.rightText: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,

units.leftText: to Him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
units.rightText: unto him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus unto all generations for ever and ever. Amen.

units.leftText: As a prisoner in the Lord, then, I urge you to walk in a manner worthy of the calling you have received:
units.rightText: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beseech you to walk worthily of the calling wherewith ye were called,

units.leftText: with all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
units.rightText: with all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;

units.leftText: and with diligence to preserve the unity of the Spirit through the bond of peace.
units.rightText: giving diligence to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

units.leftText: There is one body and one Spirit, just as you were called to one hope when you were called;
units.rightText: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as also ye were called in one hope of your calling;

units.leftText: one Lord, one faith, one baptism;
units.rightText: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

units.leftText: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in all.
units.rightText: one God and Father of all, who is over all, and through all, and in all.

units.leftText: Now to each one of us grace has been given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
units.rightText: But unto each one of us was the grace given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

units.leftText: This is why it says: “When He ascended on high, He led captives away, and gave gifts to men.”
units.rightText: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, And gave gifts unto men.

units.leftText: What does “He ascended” mean, except that He also descended to the lower parts of the earth?
units.rightText: (Now this, He ascended, what is it but that he also descended into the lower parts of the earth?
leftNotes: 4:9 BYZ and TR except that He also descended first

units.leftText: He who descended is the very One who ascended above all the heavens, in order to fill all things.
units.rightText: He that descended is the same also that ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.)

units.leftText: And it was He who gave some to be apostles, some to be prophets, some to be evangelists, and some to be pastors and teachers,
units.rightText: And he gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;

units.leftText: to equip the saints for works of ministry and to build up the body of Christ,
units.rightText: for the perfecting of the saints, unto the work of ministering, unto the building up of the body of Christ:

units.leftText: until we all reach unity in the faith and in the knowledge of the Son of God, as we mature to the full measure of the stature of Christ.
units.rightText: till we all attain unto the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a fullgrown man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:

units.leftText: Then we will no longer be infants, tossed about by the waves and carried around by every wind of teaching and by the clever cunning of men in their deceitful scheming.
units.rightText: that we may be no longer children, tossed to and fro and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;

units.leftText: Instead, speaking the truth in love, we will in all things grow up into Christ Himself, who is the head.
units.rightText: but speaking truth in love, may grow up in all things into him, who is the head, even Christ;

units.leftText: From Him the whole body, fitted and held together by every supporting ligament, grows and builds itself up in love through the work of each individual part. New Life in Christ (Colossians 3:1–17|COL 3:1-17*)
units.rightText: from whom all the body fitly framed and knit together through that which every joint supplieth, according to the working in due measure of each several part, maketh the increase of the body unto the building up of itself in love.

units.leftText: So I tell you this, and insist on it in the Lord, that you must no longer walk as the Gentiles do, in the futility of their thinking.
units.rightText: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye no longer walk as the Gentiles also walk, in the vanity of their mind,

units.leftText: They are darkened in their understanding and alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them due to the hardness of their hearts.
units.rightText: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God, because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their heart;

units.leftText: Having lost all sense of shame, they have given themselves over to sensuality for the practice of every kind of impurity, with a craving for more.
units.rightText: who being past feeling gave themselves up to lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

units.leftText: But this is not the way you came to know Christ.
units.rightText: But ye did not so learn Christ;

units.leftText: Surely you heard of Him and were taught in Him— in keeping with the truth that is in Jesus—
units.rightText: if so be that ye heard him, and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

units.leftText: to put off your former way of life, your old self, which is being corrupted by its deceitful desires;
units.rightText: that ye put away, as concerning your former manner of life, the old man, that waxeth corrupt after the lusts of deceit;

units.leftText: to be renewed in the spirit of your minds;
units.rightText: and that ye be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

units.leftText: and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.
units.rightText: and put on the new man, that after God hath been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

units.leftText: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to his neighbor, for we are all members of one another.
units.rightText: Wherefore, putting away falsehood, speak ye truth each one with his neighbor: for we are members one of another.

units.leftText: “Be angry, yet do not sin.” Do not let the sun set upon your anger,
units.rightText: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
leftNotes: 4:26 Or “In your anger do not sin.”Psalm 4:4|PSA 4:4*

units.leftText: and do not give the devil a foothold.
units.rightText: neither give place to the devil.

units.leftText: He who has been stealing must steal no longer, but must work, doing good with his own hands, that he may have something to share with the one in need.
units.rightText: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labor, working with his hands the thing that is good, that he may have whereof to give to him that hath need.

units.leftText: Let no unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building up the one in need and bringing grace to those who listen.
units.rightText: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but such as is good for edifying as the need may be, that it may give grace to them that hear.

units.leftText: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
units.rightText: And grieve not the Holy Spirit of God, in whom ye were sealed unto the day of redemption.

units.leftText: Get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, outcry and slander, along with every form of malice.
units.rightText: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamor, and railing, be put away from you, with all malice:

units.leftText: Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.
units.rightText: and be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving each other, even as God also in Christ forgave you.

units.leftText: Be imitators of God, therefore, as beloved children,
units.rightText: Be ye therefore imitators of God, as beloved children;

units.leftText: and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to God.
units.rightText: and walk in love, even as Christ also loved you, and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for an odor of a sweet smell.
leftNotes: 5:2 NE and WH Christ loved you

units.leftText: But among you, as is proper among the saints, there must not be even a hint of sexual immorality, or of any kind of impurity, or of greed.
units.rightText: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not even be named among you, as becometh saints;

units.leftText: Nor should there be obscenity, foolish talk, or crude joking, which are out of character, but rather thanksgiving.
units.rightText: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, or jesting, which are not befitting: but rather giving of thanks.

units.leftText: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater) has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
units.rightText: For this ye know of a surety, that no fornicator, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and God.

units.leftText: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of such things the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.
units.rightText: Let no man deceive you with empty words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the sons of disobedience.

units.leftText: Therefore do not be partakers with them. Children of Light
units.rightText: Be not ye therefore partakers with them;

units.leftText: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
units.rightText: for ye were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord: walk as children of light

units.leftText: for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness, righteousness, and truth.
units.rightText: (for the fruit of the light is in all goodness and righteousness and truth),

units.leftText: Test and prove what pleases the Lord.
units.rightText: proving what is well-pleasing unto the Lord;

units.leftText: Have no fellowship with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them.
units.rightText: and have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather even reprove them;

units.leftText: For it is shameful even to mention what the disobedient do in secret.
units.rightText: for the things which are done by them in secret it is a shame even to speak of.

units.leftText: But everything exposed by the light becomes visible, for everything that is illuminated becomes a light itself.
units.rightText: But all things when they are reproved are made manifest by the light: for everything that is made manifest is light.

units.leftText: So it is said: “Wake up, O sleeper, rise up from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
units.rightText: Wherefore he saith, Awake, thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall shine upon thee.

units.leftText: Pay careful attention, then, to how you walk, not as unwise but as wise,
units.rightText: Look therefore carefully how ye walk, not as unwise, but as wise;

units.leftText: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
units.rightText: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

units.leftText: Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the Lord’s will is.
units.rightText: Wherefore be ye not foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

units.leftText: Do not get drunk on wine, which leads to reckless indiscretion. Instead, be filled with the Spirit.
units.rightText: And be not drunken with wine, wherein is riot, but be filled with the Spirit;

units.leftText: Speak to one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Sing and make music in your hearts to the Lord,
units.rightText: speaking one to another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody with your heart to the Lord;

units.leftText: always giving thanks to God the Father for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ. Wives and Husbands (Song of Solomon 1:1–17|1:1-17*; 1 Peter 3:1–7|1PE 3:1-7*)
units.rightText: giving thanks always for all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;

units.leftText: Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.
units.rightText: subjecting yourselves one to another in the fear of Christ.
leftNotes: 5:21 Or in the fear of Christ.

units.leftText: Wives, submit to your husbands as to the Lord.
units.rightText: Wives, be in subjection unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.

units.leftText: For the husband is the head of the wife as Christ is the head of the church, His body, of which He is the Savior.
units.rightText: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the church, being himself the saviour of the body.

units.leftText: Now as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything.
units.rightText: But as the church is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their husbands in everything.

units.leftText: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her
units.rightText: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself up for it;

units.leftText: to sanctify her, cleansing her by the washing with water through the word,
units.rightText: that he might sanctify it, having cleansed it by the washing of water with the word,

units.leftText: and to present her to Himself as a glorious church, without stain or wrinkle or any such blemish, but holy and blameless.
units.rightText: that he might present the church to himself a glorious church, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

units.leftText: In the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.
units.rightText: Even so ought husbands also to love their own wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his own wife loveth himself:

units.leftText: Indeed, no one ever hated his own body, but he nourishes and cherishes it, just as Christ does the church.
units.rightText: for no man ever hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as Christ also the church;

units.leftText: For we are members of His body.
units.rightText: because we are members of his body.
leftNotes: 5:30 BYZ and TR include —of His flesh and of His bones.

units.leftText: “For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.”
units.rightText: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh.

units.leftText: This mystery is profound, but I am speaking about Christ and the church.
units.rightText: This mystery is great: but I speak in regard of Christ and of the church.

units.leftText: Nevertheless, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.
units.rightText: Nevertheless do ye also severally love each one his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she fear her husband.

units.leftText: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
units.rightText: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.

units.leftText: “Honor your father and mother” (which is the first commandment with a promise),
units.rightText: Honor thy father and mother (which is the first commandment with promise),

units.leftText: “that it may go well with you and that you may have a long life on the earth.”
units.rightText: that it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.

units.leftText: Fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath; instead, bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord. Serving with Honor (Colossians 3:22–25|COL 3:22-25*; 1 Timothy 6:1–2|1TI 6:1-2*)
units.rightText: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but nurture them in the chastening and admonition of the Lord.

units.leftText: Slaves, obey your earthly masters with respect and fear and sincerity of heart, just as you would obey Christ.
units.rightText: Servants, be obedient unto them that according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;

units.leftText: And do this not only to please them while they are watching, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from your heart.
units.rightText: not in the way of eyeservice, as men-pleasers; but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;

units.leftText: Serve with good will, as to the Lord and not to men,
units.rightText: with good will doing service, as unto the Lord, and not unto men:

units.leftText: because you know that the Lord will reward each one for whatever good he does, whether he is slave or free.
units.rightText: knowing that whatsoever good thing each one doeth, the same shall he receive again from the Lord, whether he be bond or free.

units.leftText: And masters, do the same for your slaves. Give up your use of threats, because you know that He who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no favoritism with Him. The Full Armor of God
units.rightText: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, and forbear threatening: knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no respect of persons with him.

units.leftText: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.
units.rightText: Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.

units.leftText: Put on the full armor of God, so that you can make your stand against the devil’s schemes.
units.rightText: Put on the whole armor of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

units.leftText: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this world’s darkness, and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
units.rightText: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world-rulers of this darkness, against the spiritual hosts of wickedness in the heavenly places.

units.leftText: Therefore take up the full armor of God, so that when the day of evil comes, you will be able to stand your ground, and having done everything, to stand.
units.rightText: Wherefore take up the whole armor of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and, having done all, to stand.

units.leftText: Stand firm then, with the belt of truth buckled around your waist, with the breastplate of righteousness arrayed,
units.rightText: Stand therefore, having girded your loins with truth, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

units.leftText: and with your feet fitted with the readiness of the gospel of peace.
units.rightText: and having shod your feet with the preparation of the gospel of peace;

units.leftText: In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
units.rightText: withal taking up the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.

units.leftText: And take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.
units.rightText: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:

units.leftText: Pray in the Spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and petition. To this end, stay alert with all perseverance in your prayers for all the saints.
units.rightText: with all prayer and supplication praying at all seasons in the Spirit, and watching thereunto in all perseverance and supplication for all the saints,

units.leftText: Pray also for me, that whenever I open my mouth, words may be given me so that I will boldly make known the mystery of the gospel,
units.rightText: and on my behalf, that utterance may be given unto me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the gospel,

units.leftText: for which I am an ambassador in chains. Pray that I may proclaim it fearlessly, as I should. Final Greetings (Philippians 4:21–23|PHP 4:21-23*; 2 Timothy 4:19–22|2TI 4:19-22*)
units.rightText: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

units.leftText: Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything, so that you also may know about me and what I am doing.
units.rightText: But that ye also may know my affairs, how I do, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:

units.leftText: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know about us, and that he may encourage your hearts.
units.rightText: whom I have sent unto you for this very purpose, that ye may know our state, and that he may comfort your hearts.

units.leftText: Peace to the brothers and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

units.leftText: Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.
units.rightText: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ with a love incorruptible.
